posts.caption:
MENVA, in one sentence: scan the QR on your table, tap a dish, and the exact plate, same size, same everything, lands on your table before you order it.

No app. No download. Safari ya Chrome mein khul jata hai, bas.

Yeh menu ki tasveer nahi, asli plate ka 3D scan hai. Jo dikhega, wahi aayega.

Build your list, show the waiter, order like you already know what's coming. Waiter still takes the order, hum sirf dikhate hain.

Try it tonight, link in bio, ya us dost ko bhej do jo order karne mein 20 minute laga deta hai. Tum jaante ho kaun.

posts.caption:
Ordering for eight without the group chat descending into chaos. Aik tested method:

1. One person holds the menu, seriously, just one.
2. Sharing plates first.
3. See the portion before you commit.

5. Build one list. Show the waiter.

Aik banda menu pakre, baaki chup. Set hai?
